outline:
本課程欲利用人工智慧技術實作量化交易系統。於課程中會參考研讀多篇國外相關文獻，討論後結合當下題目，進行實驗分析並且實作。我們將於期末發表技術報告與成果展。本課程建議先行修過演算法交易、資金管理、以及人工智慧或機器學習相關課程，並有基本程式語言能力。
This course intends to use artificial intelligence technology to implement a quantitative trading system. During the course, many relevant academic paper will be studied and discussed, and implemented after discussion. Finally, the technical report will be published as the result at the end of the semester. This course is recommended to take pre-courses in algorithmic trading, money management, and artificial intelligence or machine learning, and have basic programming language skills.
schedule:
1~3. 人工智慧與量化交易
4~6. 文獻搜尋與閱讀
7~8. 研究題目與方向確認
9~11. 實驗設計與實作
12~15 論文寫作
16~18. 簡報與成果展 (與精誠資訊合作)
assessment:
課堂討論 40%
期末論文發表 60%
materials:
